title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Crocoblock…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Crocoblock JetEngine up to version 3.9.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of a user's browser.
